title: Developer done-gate policy
description: Thresholds for the developer done-gate. Values are data and may be edited; the SHAPE is derived from open-brain/src/harness/policies.ts and this file must not be edited by hand. LIMIT: whether tests passed is read from process exit codes and is never asked of the gate; no threshold here can make a red build green. PROVENANCE: docs/HOH-JEV.md §4 gives the RULES (hand to QA when diff_matches_plan is high, touches_out_of_scope low and tests green; roll back when stuck_repeating_prior_failure is high, or risk_of_regression is high AND tests failed) and no numbers at all. Every number in the shipped developer-done.json is the developer's starting position.
